faq.q: What technical courses do you offer for the oil and gas industry?
faq.a: 65+ courses: well drilling and workover, oil and gas production, refining and petrochemicals, pipeline transport, industrial safety, instrumentation and automation, geology and geophysics.

faq.q: How much does training for oil and gas specialists cost?
faq.a: On the 2026 schedule — {minPrice} to {maxPrice} ₸ per participant, depending on the course and format. Online is cheaper than in person.

faq.q: Do you have courses on industrial safety?
faq.a: Yes, we have courses on industrial safety in the oil and gas sector, hydrogen sulphide safety, occupational safety and HSE management. The programmes meet RK legal requirements.

faq.q: Do you travel to the fields for training?
faq.a: Yes, we run corporate training on site in Atyrau, Aktau, Mangystau, Kyzylorda and other oil and gas regions of Kazakhstan.
All trainers are practising experts with 10+ years in the oil and gas industry.

faq.q: What certificate do I get after a technical course?
faq.a: At the end of the course you receive a personal Abadan & Co. certificate of professional development.
